typography.guidelines: Manrope for titles, IBM Plex Sans for everything else. Keep type quiet like Cicle: 13–14px body, 13.5px column names, 14px card titles. Do not use mono on kanban chrome, breadcrumbs, or section labels.

colors.archetype: Cicle-like workspace — light gray board, white cards, forest green, warm yellow selection

specific_adjustments.sidebar_active_row: warm yellow #F6E7B0, no left accent bar

colors.guidelines: Match Cicle contrast: almost-white sidebar, #EFEFEF board, #E6E6E6 columns, white cards with a 1px-soft shadow (no card border). Selected team is warm yellow, not a blue tint. Avatars are circular forest green. Task-detail action buttons are medium gray, not navy.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Airy Cicle board — gray columns, white cards, compact chrome
spacing_and_layout.guidelines: Kanban has no page heading. Columns are 272px, 10px padding, 10px radius, no border. Cards 14px padding, 8px radius, soft shadow. Topbar row1 48px, tabs 42px with black underline. Task modal is wide, white, gray action stack on the right.

motion.guidelines: Every interactive element gets a targeted transition (never `transition: all`): buttons lift on hover and scale down slightly on press; tabs and nav items animate background/color; kanban cards, overview cards, and list rows fade+rise in on mount (`riseIn` keyframe); modals and dropdowns fade+scale in (`modalIn`); the unread notification dot pulses (`pulseDot`). Keyframes live in index.css and are reused across App.css/team.css/extra.css.

kanban_cards.guidelines: White cards on gray columns, no border, soft shadow. Title 14px. Due date is plain gray unless overdue (red pill, white text) or done (green pill, white text). Circular avatar bottom-left. No visible priority dot. Menu appears on hover.

sidebar.guidelines: White sidebar, pill search. Active item is warm yellow (#F6E7B0) with dark text and no inset bar. Team dots stay gray/team-color.

topbar.guidelines: 48px first row. Breadcrumb: Beranda › tim › Tugas - Kanban. Tabs underline in ink, not accent. Filter/Kanban/Arsip sit in the kanban toolbar. Account actions live in the avatar menu.

task_detail_modal.guidelines: Spacious white modal. Status circle + title + 'di dalam list X di tim Y'. Gray KELOLA TUGAS / AKSI buttons. Light filled dropzone, not dashed. Comment input is a pill.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT touch or remove any existing `data-testid` attributes in the JS files.
2. Do NOT change the LABEL_COLORS swatch palette values (CreateTeamModal.jsx / TaskDetailModal.jsx) — they are embedded in generated data-testid strings.
3. All visual styling lives in App.css, extra.css, team.css and the font import in index.css — prefer editing those over adding inline styles or Tailwind classes to JSX.
4. Keep class names stable; only change declarations inside existing rules or add new rules for a genuinely new class.

5. Reuse the CSS custom properties defined in App.css :root (--paper, --surface, --ink, --muted, --line, --accent, --accent-hover, --accent-tint, --select, --column, --action, --action-hover, --success, --danger, --warning, --violet, --teal, --rose, --r-sm, --r-md, --r-lg, --font-heading, --font-body, --font-mono) instead of hardcoding new hex values.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep cards sharp for dense data tools.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern, sharp button styles (e.g., 6px radius) with interaction animations for dashboard context.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
